questions.label: English Studies · Comprehension
questions.explanation: The passage states both that Musa left early and that he carried an umbrella because rain was expected.
questions.prompt: Musa left home early because the road often became crowded before school. He also carried an umbrella after hearing the weather forecast. Select exactly TWO conclusions supported by the passage.
options: Musa wanted to avoid heavy traffic.
Musa expected that it might rain.
Musa knew the road would be empty all morning.
answers: Musa wanted to avoid heavy traffic.
Musa expected that it might rain.
